title: bicchia albida var. tricuspis
intro: Bicchia albida var. tricuspis, commonly known as Fenugreek, is a plant species in the pea family (Fabaceae) native to the Indian subcontinent and the Mediterranean region. Fenugreek is used to treat various health conditions, including diabetes, digestive issues, and menopausal symptoms, due to its ability to lower blood sugar levels and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Fenugreek include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Fenugreek include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, such as trigonelline and 4-hydroxyisoleucine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
